summary.text: Kwararafa, the Jukun-led confederacy of the Benue, was a raiding power in the 17th century: its cavalry emptied Kano three times and attacked Katsina and Zazzau, but its siege of Ngazargamu failed.

arms.text: Kwararafa built up its army with cavalry.
A confederacy: Jukun, Igala, Idoma, Alago and others marched under its banner.
The Aku Uka’s sacred kingship at Wukari.

record.text: Kwararafa invaded Kano three times. Under Muhammad Zaki and again under Dadi its people fled to Daura, and in the 1650s Adashu broke down the Kofan Kawayi gate.
With Tuareg allies Kwararafa besieged Ngazargamu, but Mai Ali set the two armies against each other and beat both.
The army sent to make Idah pay tribute was beaten by Attah Ayegba.
A Chamba invasion drove the last king of Kwararafa into exile.
Gombe and Muri took Pindiga, Kalam and the Kona country from the Jukun; Wukari itself held out.
